name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa
insider_take: This sprawling Hill Country oasis sits on 600 acres of pristine Texas landscape, where championship golf meets authentic cowboy culture just 20 minutes from downtown San Antonio.
whats_special: The resort features the TPC San Antonio golf courses that host the PGA Tour's Valero Texas Open annually. The property includes a working ranch with longhorn cattle, offering guests authentic horseback riding experiences through native Texas terrain. The spa incorporates indigenous limestone and local botanicals in treatments inspired by ancient Native American healing traditions.
pro_tip: Book a sunrise hot air balloon ride over the Hill Country - the resort can arrange exclusive launches from their grounds with champagne breakfast upon landing.
dont_miss: The Canyons Course 17th hole offers stunning views of the Texas Hill Country, while the River Walk is just a short drive away. Experience the nightly cattle drive at sunset, followed by s'mores around the resort's fire pits under the expansive Texas sky.
pros: Championship TPC San Antonio golf courses on-site
Luxurious full-service spa with Hill Country views
Multiple dining options including award-winning restaurants
Expansive resort amenities with pools and recreational activities
cons: Large resort property requiring transportation between areas
Premium pricing for luxury amenities and services
